notes: Official WinSW-x64.exe from the v2.12.0 GitHub release (self-contained). Validated PE (MZ). create-release copies this binary into release tools/vendor/winsw/ and validates SHA-256.
replacementProcedure: 1. Download WinSW-x64.exe from downloadUrl (keep version pin).
